citation: Wright, J. S. Chicago, drawn by J. S. Wright according to survey. New York: P. A. Mesier's Lith., 1834.
author: John Stephen Wright
repository: Norman B. Leventhal Map & Education Center, Boston Public Library
locator: identifier 06_01_016718; manuscript map in ink and watercolour, 46 x 37 cm, scale approx. 1:7,200
note: MASTER GEOMETRY SOURCE. Open rights, and already published as a georeferenced GeoTIFF (69.4 MB) with live Allmaps georeferencing on the item page — which is why this and not the Newberry Hathaway surrogate is the primary warping raster. A genuine survey at 1:7,200 with block and lot lines, coloured to indicate date surveyed. Shows the cut through the sandbar giving the river direct lake access. Verified 2026-08-09: like Hathaway, this sheet shows lot geometry and the river, NOT individual buildings. No period map this project holds gives a building footprint for 1835 Chicago — footprints come from textual dimensions where they are attested and are conjectural otherwise.
